long_biography.plain_text:
Tatravagónka is the centre of Alexej Beljajev Sr's industrial group. He and business partner Michal Lazar took control of the struggling Poprad freight-wagon factory in the mid-2000s, then expanded the business across Central Europe and into India. It became one of Europe's largest producers of freight wagons and bogies.

Beljajev began in foreign trade and logistics before moving into private engineering. By 1995 he was leading ZTS Sabinov, a gearbox manufacturer that joined his wider industrial portfolio. ZTS Sabinov produces specialised gearboxes and related components for industrial and vehicle applications.
